definitions.explanation: Countries outside of Japan, typically accessed by crossing the sea.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}きたい→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
{海外|かいがい}⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This is my first trip abroad.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{海外|かいがい}⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。

notes:
{海外|かいがい} means overseas or abroad—countries beyond Japan's shores.

COMPONENTS:
{海|かい} (sea) + {外|がい} (outside) = beyond the sea

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {海外|かいがい}{旅行|りょこう}: overseas travel
- {海外|かいがい}{出張|しゅっちょう}: business trip abroad
- {海外|かいがい}{留学|りゅうがく}: studying abroad
- {海外|かいがい}{赴任|ふにん}: overseas assignment
- {海外|かいがい}{進出|しんしゅつ}: overseas expansion (business)

CONTRAST WITH {外国|がいこく}:
- {海外|かいがい}: emphasizes 'across the sea' from Japan's perspective
- {外国|がいこく}: foreign country (more general term)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {海外|かいがい}に{行|い}く: to go abroad
- {海外|かいがい}で{働|はたら}く: to work overseas
- {海外|かいがい}から{来|く}る: to come from abroad

{国内|こくない} (domestic) is the opposite of {海外|かいがい}.
